misc.guideSummaryKo: 지평선 45%, 소실점 왼쪽 밖·오른쪽 밖, 모서리 30%
misc.cameraSentence: Camera: two-point perspective looking at a corner: the horizon line is at about 39% of the image height from the bottom, one vanishing point is far outside the picture on the left and the other is far outside the picture on the right; vertical lines stay vertical. The front corner where the two sides of the building meet is a vertical line at about 30% of the image width from the left, running from below the bottom edge of the picture up to past the top edge of the picture. The two vanishing points are far apart, so the perspective is gentle.

content.text:
Aspect ratio: 16:9 (the image will be 2048x1152).
Time of day: day
Place: exterior
Perspective chosen by the artist: two-point perspective. Camera sentence, copy it verbatim as item 4: "Camera: two-point perspective looking at a corner: the horizon line is at about 39% of the image height from the bottom, one vanishing point is far outside the picture on the left and the other is far outside the picture on the right; vertical lines stay vertical. The front corner where the two sides of the building meet is a vertical line at about 30% of the image width from the left, running from below the bottom edge of the picture up to past the top edge of the picture. The two vanishing points are far apart, so the perspective is gentle."
Image 1: rough sketch by our artist (layout source).
Style examples: auto mode. Choose up to two from this style library (their small thumbnails follow the input images):
  L1: 학교 앞 횡단보도 (exterior, day)
  L2: 아파트 집 안 (현관에서 본 거실) (interior, day)
  L3: 공원 벤치 (exterior, day)
  L4: 작은 집 방 (소파, 에어컨) (interior, day)
  L5: 아파트 공동현관 (낮) (exterior, day)
  L6: 아파트 공동현관 (밤) (exterior, night)
  L7: 아파트 단지와 거리 (exterior, day)
  L8: 초등학교 교실 (interior, day)
  L9: 나무 아지트 안 (interior, any)
  L10: 공중화장실 (interior, any)
  L11: 공원 정자 (exterior, day)
  L12: 놀이터 (exterior, day)
Base style strip: always sent as the last image. In the prompt write {BASE} for its number and {S1}, {S2} for the style examples.
